fal_postmaster.text: The Falklands have issued their own stamps since 1878, and wildlife is the favourite subject: penguins, albatrosses, sea lions, wild flowers. The Philatelic Bureau sells to collectors around the world, and the money helps pay for the islands' roads and schools.
A card from here usually takes a week or two to reach Britain by the Airbridge. It has a very long route. It is quite worth it for the stamp.
